entries.en: My opinion: these guys aren't backed by their government. They've got to be working on their own.
I just don't want the Terra Firma Party using a threat to my home as an excuse to invade somebody else's.
You were on the ground when this happened. How many batarians have you seen, and where?
The Conventions only apply to Council-aligned races. The batarian government is a rogue state.
If the batarians can't keep their own crazies in line, we'll do it for them.
We can worry about who to blame later.
Batarians everywhere, and I need to shut down all three torches. Anything else I should know?
Any idea where I can find them?
I think I found them. Their bodies, anyway.
I already found two of them. They didn't make it.
I came across a member of your crew. He didn't make it.
A woman named Kate Bowman contacted me. The batarians haven't found her yet.
You'd better find a good place to hide. If the batarians come back and find you...
Why was this place surrounded by blasting caps?
I ran into a field of blasting caps. You know anything about them?
Stay here. I'm going to go remind some batarians about Mindoir.
Time's running short. I'm going to go punch this mountain into space.
Most batarians aren't genocidal madmen. But these ones are terrorists.
They're not all like this.
Enemy numbers
Why wouldn't they?
I understand the situation.
It doesn't matter now.
Where would your crew be?
It's too late for them.
Two are dead.
At least one is dead.
One of them got away.
Stay out of sight.
Blasting caps
Time for some payback.
Oh, god!
I didn't mean to... are you hurt?
Sorry. I didn't even realize you were human until... well. Guess I'm not much of a soldier.
Sorry. I thought you were one of them.
Yeah, okay. I'll remember that.
Takes more than that one shot to bring me down.
You can't go firing your weapon at everything that moves! What the hell's wrong with you?
Here's a tip: two eyes, human. Four eyes, batarian.
Leave the fighting to me from now on. Commander Shepard, Systems Alliance.
My shields took the hit. No damage done. I'm with the Alliance. Commander Shepard.
What were you thinking?
Are you blind, or just stupid?
I think that's all I need.
Yeah, I think I'll make myself scarce. Good luck, Shepard.
The Conventions don't apply.
Get in there.
Aaron.
Tell us who you've been helping.
I won't ask you again.
Get her out of here.
And you. Find this problem and deal with it.
Who's shutting down the torches?
Find this problem and deal with it!
Don't come any closer.
We can do this hard way... or we can end this peacefully.
Look, I'm just doing my job here. Hijacking this rock wasn't my idea.
I signed on to make a little profit. A quick slave grab. Nothing more.
I don't think so. Balak would skin me alive and sell my hide out of spite.
Crazy bastard. This whole mission's gone to hell and I'm gonna pay for it.
Huh. Maybe.
I had a bad feeling about this from the moment we landed. Now Balak wants you dead.
And what Balak wants, Balak gets. I can't change that.
An, uh, interesting proposal. It certainly has benefits over the current situation.
Shut it down. This is Balak's problem now.
I hope you're as quick with a gun as you are with your promises. For both our sakes.
Perfectly.
Balak's holed up in the main facility. You'll need this to get in.
Don't underestimate him. He's a mean bastard.
Let's go. We're getting off this rock.
Hold it right there. This doesn't have to end in bloodshed.
Get him! No one leaves.
Get her! No one leaves.
I didn't think you batarians knew the meaning of the word.
Balak's a dead man. And if I ever see you in human territory again, so are you. Understand?
I've got nothing to say to a batarian terrorist.
That's reason enough for me.
Maybe you should take your men and go. Before you get hurt.
So why do you listen to him?
You keep listening to this Balak and you'll end up dead.
Do you always want to be second in command? Get me out of here and I'll take care of Balak. Then you can start giving the orders.
But I can!
Spoken like a true lackey. You get me out of here and I'll take care of Balak. Or you can take your chances with me.
Balak will get what's coming to him. And so will you if I ever catch you in human territory again. Are we clear?
Balak will be dead before you get off the asteroid.
Peacefully?
Quicker.
It'll be fine.
I doubt that.
[Attack him]
Why follow him?
Yes you will.
Forget Balak.
Well, it's not too late. You can still leave.
Then go.
Don't you think I know that?
I'm just following orders here. If it were up to me, we'd have already left.
This isn't just a slave grab anymore. Millions of people are going to die.
It's gone too far.
It *is* up to you.
[Grunt] You humans think you're so superior.
But you're no better than us. I gave you a chance to save them and you threw it away [cough]. Who's the real terrorist here?
[laughs] You'll have to do better than that if you want to stop us.
You humans.
You're almost more trouble than you're worth.
Predictable. But this is over.
I don't answer to the Council! Or to you.
I'm leaving this asteroid. If you try to stop me, I'll detonate these charges and your helper and her friends are all going to die.
You and I are nothing alike. You killed those people. You pushed the button. And now you'll pay for it.
I'm just getting started.
Let the hostages go and maybe you'll live long enough to explain yourself to the Council.
You're delirious.
[Fire Warning Shot]
A lot more.
Maybe. But I made sure you won't follow me today. Those charges are still on a timer.
I hope this is worth it!
I'm going to enjoy gutting you.
Go ahead, kill me. I'm not afraid to die. But know this...
[coughs] One day soon, the human race is going to pay for what it's done.
It is a crusade [coughs]... and we won't stop until we wipe your filth from the universe.
No! Not this time. We've learned from our mistakes. We'll be ready.
[grunting] Damn it. [grunting] You think killing me will make a difference?
There are thousands more like me, waiting their turn. Each one willing to die for our cause.
Believe what you want.
When the vids flash with images of your colonies in flames, you'll know the batarian rebellion has begun [coughing].
[screams] What? What do you want? Details? It doesn't matter... [gasp].... It's too late for you.
[spits] I'm through talking.
[coughs] Just kill me. Get it over with.
You can go. But this isn't over. I'll find you eventually.
I'm not letting a terrorist like you go free. Do what you want with the others, but it'll be the last thing you do!
You're just a demented madman who gets off on killing humans. Don't try to make it sound like some holy crusade.
Do you really think the result would be any different this time? An attack against us would be suicide.
Then die already...
And they chose you for this mission? Then I guess we have nothing to worry about.
Who's your leader? Who's orchestrating all this?
Killing you is too much of a mercy. You can die... slowly.
You're not going to die. We'll drop you off on Terra Nova and let Alliance officials deal with you. I doubt they'll be too friendly.
You never learn.
[Graze him]
[Kill him]
Thousands?
[Wound Him]
A rebellion?
[Leave him to die]
[Leave him for the Alliance]
[Let him go to save hostages]
This isn't over... [coughs]. This is just the beginning for the batarian nation.
Really? You invaded our space. Took our resources. And when we asked the Council for aid, they brushed us off.
Didn't do anything? Aside from colonizing a world that could have been ours? Aside from using resources that should have been ours?
It was you. You and your kind are the only reason we're in this position.
